title: Understanding Prior Bias and Choice Paralysis in Transformer-based Language Representation Models through Four Experimental Probes
reasoning: The paper investigates 'prior bias' and 'choice paralysis' in transformer-based NLU models, which are performance-related biases, not explicitly ethical, moral, or faith-based evaluations. While biases can have ethical implications, the paper's focus is on model behavior and performance under specific perturbations, not on the ethical content of its decisions or its understanding of moral/religious concepts.
